name: commandbuffer-chunk1222
note: Console line editing, yank buffer, and the scaled prompt draw from c_commandbuffer.cpp (1-337).
auditSeams: Cell size divides the new-console font width by 9. The prompt and cursor use the current console font widths of 0x1c and 0x0b. Column count is ConCols divided by the active console scale. Pasted bytes are read by GetCharFromString, which maps Windows-1252 0x80-0x9F and otherwise UTF-8. GetText encodes each code point with utf8_encode and drops a code point that encoder rejects. The copy constructor copies the text and the two cursors and leaves the column count, yank buffer, and cell counters at zero.
auditRationale: UNCredited c_commandbuffer.cpp 1-337 (+337). The file ends at 337. A full tally line scan shows no overlap.
